question: Are the four mediator packages viable and reliable without the two Duskblade Energy refunds that pushed RandomBuild to its ceiling?

shippingChangesAtThisStage: Keep the current-main card catalogue and reward pools unchanged.
Keep the four aspect-gated mediators and their conditional damage or Ward responses.
Do not refund Energy when Scoreline or Afterimage is consumed.

researchCohorts.cemTrain: six Duskblade-v5 islands, generations 0-5, eight CRN seeds per generation, 182000-182047
researchCohorts.finalValidation: all six frozen final policies, paired candidate/live, 184000-184063

competingOptions.statement: Conditional damage and Ward alone retain four packages, Dusk endpoints and clear controls.
Local activation, endpoint C2, retention, reliability or Vow-5 fails without refund tempo.

estimands.routeViability: At least two final policies per route activate the mediator and beat held-out RandomBuild arm 2 by at least 0.35.
estimands.retention: At least two distinct final policies remain within 0.10 of the overall top, and route-best rates remain within 0.10.
estimands.reliability: No CEM holdout fault and no candidate-added stall or simulator error.
estimands.vow5: Every final-policy validation win rate is at most 0.90.

successRule.local: All four packages pass functional separation, activation, aspect separation, duration and stall gates.
successRule.routeViability: At least two independently fitted final policies per assigned route meet activation and the 0.35 C2 margin.
successRule.retention: Both assigned routes retain distinct endpoints without collapse.
successRule.reliability: Zero simulator errors and no candidate-added stalls.
successRule.vow5: All final-policy win rates are at most 0.90.

cheapestDiscriminatingExperiment: Run 32-pair separation and policy panels, then their independent validation. Run controls before the existing six-island mini-CEM.
inconclusiveRule: Only a non-decisive policy-panel result may extend once from 32 to 128 pairs. CEM and the 64-seed final rectangle are final.
stopRule: Reject on a failed local gate, broad movement, fault, fewer than two C2 endpoints per route, collapse, added stall/error or Vow-5 above 0.90. Detector mutations remain forbidden until the repertoire passes.
